summary: The failures point to numeric UTC-offset parsing: explicitly signed offsets shift parsed times in the wrong direction, and `%z`/`%Ez` accept the incomplete offset `-1`. The current CCTZ parser implementation is missing from the evidence, so the repair location and boundary behavior cannot yet be confirmed.
hypotheses: The CCTZ numeric-offset parser applies the sign with the wrong polarity, shifting valid timestamps by twice the offset.
The CCTZ offset parser accepts incomplete hour-only forms such as `-1`, causing malformed input to succeed.
